Starting again is not starting from zero.

The last attempt was not wasted. It taught you what to keep, what to drop and what you are able to carry. You begin this time with all of that.

What is one thing your last try taught you?

Save this for the day you need it.

#keepgoing #startagain #motivation #nevergiveup #riseup

Falling was never the end of the sentence.

"For a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again." Proverbs 24:16 (WEB)

The verse does not pretend the fall away. It counts seven of them, and then it keeps going. Getting up is part of the story too.

What are you getting back up from this week?

Send this to someone who is still trying.

#proverbs #bibleverse #faith #hope #keepgoing

He lost the Senate race. Two years later he won the presidency.

In 1858 Abraham Lincoln lost to Stephen Douglas. Days later he wrote to a friend that the fight must go on, even after one hundred defeats. In 1860 he was elected president.

Which loss are you still carrying?

Save this for the day you need it.

#abrahamlincoln #history #perseverance #keepgoing #nevergiveup

Fall seven times, stand up eight.

This Japanese proverb does not count the falls to shame you. It counts them to show there is always one more rising than falling. The last number is the one that matters.

Which number are you on today?

#japaneseproverb #proverb #wisdom #resilience #keepgoing

What changed for patients this year, in plain words.

In a phase 3 trial of 563 people with extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer, adding tarlatamab to durvalumab maintenance gave a median survival of 21.1 months, against 12.7 with durvalumab alone. It is an interim result and not a cure. Source: N Engl J Med 2026, doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2609482.

Who do you hope for today?

#cancerresearch #lungcancer #hope #oncology #science

As a child she wore a leg brace. She won three Olympic golds.

Wilma Rudolph survived polio and scarlet fever. Her doctor said she would never walk again. Her mother said she would, and Wilma believed her mother. In Rome in 1960 she won three gold medals.

Who believed in you before you did?

Send this to someone who is still trying.

#wilmarudolph #perseverance #olympics #inspiration #keepgoing

What would you restart today if no one was keeping score?

Sometimes the thing that stops us is not the work. It is the fear of being seen to begin again. Today nobody is counting.

Tell us in one word what you would restart.
